svg.title: VectolynCloud release banner template
svg.desc: Text layer over png/release-banner-background.png. Pixelify Sans 700, outline to paths before export. One font pixel u = 0.09143 em. Tracking -0.0286 em (one font pixel between letters). Cap height 7u. y values are cap tops. Text column x 80 to 860; the 3D mark owns the area right of it. Block is centered vertically: wordmark (u 3) + 20 + version (7u) + 24 + title/date (u 3). version: u 12, falls back to 10, 8, 6 until it fits 780 px. Points of MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH in gold #FFD23F, rest #ECEEF4. title: first line of the tag message, u 3, #ECEEF4, max 48 characters, cut at a word end with an ellipsis, then shortened word by word if title + date exceed 780 px. Empty title: the line holds only the date. date: "Oct 30, 2026", u 3, #9EA3B8, after a 6 x 6 gold square with 18 px on each side. badge: SemVer prerelease -alpha.N ALPHA #FF6B6B, -beta.N BETA #FFD23F, -rc.N RC #00E5FF, other PRE-RELEASE #9EA3B8; stable: no badge. u 3, text #14111F, padding 2u x 1u (height 9u), corners cut by 1u, 12 px right of the wordmark, centered on its cap height.
